subject: SundialTech AWS co-launch: marketplace listing & PDM/PSM sync
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sundialtech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SundialTech AWS co-launch: marketplace listing & PDM/PSM sync

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time last week. SundialTech’s usage patterns look like a great fit for a co-sell marketplace listing on AWS. I wanted to outline the immediate next steps to get the listing started and to coordinate PDM/PSM alignment so AWS has the customer-facing contacts.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm a 30–45m technical + commercial sync (we can include your procurement rep)
- Share a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out AWS milestones + our listing timeline
- Collect the minimal marketplace artifacts (logo, short description, pricing band, contact email) — attached is a checklist we normally use

Can you confirm who from your side should be on the kickoff (technical lead + procurement)? I’m flexible Thurs or Fri morning PT.

Attaching: Sundial_Marketplace_Requirements_v1.pdf (artifact checklist)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0129

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sundialtech.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sundialtech.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SundialTech AWS co-launch: marketplace listing & PDM/PSM sync

Lauren —

Appreciate the checklist — that helps a lot. We are definitely interested in the marketplace route and co-sell engagement. On attendees: I will join, and I will loop in Maya Patel (tech lead) and our procurement alias (included).

Thurs or Fri morning ET works for us; prefer Thu 11am ET. A couple of quick asks before we commit calendar time:
- Can you sketch a MAP (high level) so our procurement team can see milestone cadence and deliverables?
- We have a short security questionnaire — who on your team handles packaging evidence (SOC2, retention, logging)?

If you can send a simple MAP and confirm who owns security evidence on Redwood’s side, I’ll get procurement to review.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Sundial Technologies
alex.johnson@sundialtech.com
+1 212-555-0199

Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SundialTech AWS co-launch: marketplace listing & PDM/PSM sync

Team — FYI, Sundial is keen to move forward and wants a MAP + clarity on who handles security evidence. They proposed Thu 11am ET for the kickoff.

Quick notes / ask:
- Kimberly: can you be the PDM lead for Sundial (customer success + listing artifacts)?
- Karthik: can you cover PSM responsibilities (co-sell motions and AWS-facing GTM)?
- Ben: can you reduce MAP to an editable spreadsheet (I’ve attached a starter) and own procurement touchpoints?

I attached a proposed MAP (Sundial_Proposed_MAP.xlsx) — please add milestones: AWS listing draft, pricing sign-off, Partner Central submission, co-sell RAF meeting.

I’ll confirm Thu 11am ET with Alex after you ack.

Thanks,
Lauren

> Attachment: Sundial_Proposed_MAP.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sundialtech.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SundialTech AWS co-launch: marketplace listing & PDM/PSM sync

Hi Alex —

Nice to e-meet. I’m Kimberly (PDM on the Redwood side) focused on marketplace artifacts and launch readiness. Karthik will be your PSM contact for co-sell orchestration on the AWS side.

For the security questionnaire: Redwood’s Security & Compliance team centralizes evidence delivery. I’ll own gathering the commonly requested items (SOC 2 report, retention policy summary, basic network diagram). If you send the questionnaire we’ll route it to the compliance team and come back with a completed package within 5 business days.

I’ve added a few proposed MAP milestones below for the kickoff call:
- Day 0: Kickoff + artifact check (logo, short desc, pricing band)
- Day 3: Draft listing copy + internal review
- Day 7: Pricing approval + Partner Central draft submission
- Day 14: Final review + publish window request to AWS

Confirmed: Thu 11am ET is good for our team. Please share calendar invite and any procurement-specific templates you want included.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Product Delivery Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Kimberly / Lauren —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP outline. Thu 11am ET is on our calendar. I’ve invited Maya (technical) and our procurement rep, Jesse (procurement@ sundialtech.com).

Two final items before the call:
1) Procurement asked for a simple commercial template (high-level SOW/ordering flow). Can Ben share that?
2) We will also attach our security questionnaire in advance — look for it shortly.

If either of you want to triage anything ahead of the call, I’m available this afternoon. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Alex
